title: Reconcile unreferenced immutable evaluation source files after restart
outcome: A bounded startup reconciliation removes only host-owned evaluation source files that no persisted or in-flight attempt can still consume, preserving replay custody on uncertain outcomes.
acceptance: Startup reconciliation preserves every file referenced by a persisted open evaluation write and every active consumer, including unknown or unacknowledged persistence outcomes.

Only validated host-owned UUID regular files inside canonical private evaluation storage are eligible for cleanup; crash-before-Pending and abandoned/unreferenced files are eventually removed without following external locators.
Behavioral crash/restart fixtures demonstrate preservation of referenced files and cleanup of unreferenced files; exact review and validation evidence is recorded.
